snapshots.title: RockSolid source and compatibility
snapshots.content:
Verified package: rocksolidjs. Source revision: 908ec4bf1534b36bf34bb9028ed8639cf773c205. The component source is free under the MIT license.
Runtime and CSS evidence: solid-js ^1.9.5; preview pinned to 1.9.15, tailwindcss ^4.1.4; preview compiled with 4.3.3.
The documented CSS setup imports tailwindcss and rocksolidjs/index.css and registers @source for rocksolidjs. Components use the shipped default theme; ThemeProvider is optional for theme overrides. RTL layout uses logical CSS and rtl: utilities. The pinned Tabs source does not reverse ArrowLeft/ArrowRight behavior for RTL.
